overall: MARGINAL this afternoon, calm and dry tonight
limiterDetail: The main limiter is current, with wind second. Decabaitot, Tara, Turda and Alava run 1.0–1.4 kt now and build to 1.5–1.9 kt around 5–6 PM. ECMWF wind is 10–13 kt now (Nangalao up to 14 kt around 4–5 PM), then drops to 5–8 kt by 7–9 PM and stays light overnight. Rain is not a factor: under 1 mm over the next 24h everywhere.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. Latest: Tropical Cyclone Warning, Typhoon Rosal (Champi) Signal #2 and Signal #1, updated Fri 23 Oct 10:46 AM PHT, for the far north only. Other recent items are flood advisories for Cagayan Valley, none covering Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: No material change to supply: today's arrivals stay thin, and recovery from Saturday is on track. The grounds look better this afternoon: 2 GOOD / 9 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 0 / 7 / 7 / 2 this morning). Coron and Galoc are GOOD again, Cabunlawan, Culion and Binudac improved to MARGINAL, and Decabaitot and Tara eased from VERY POOR to POOR.

Next week: Sunday 25 is now the calmest day (5.0 kt, gusts 9, dry). The midweek rain spread out: Tue 27 is now moderate (5.6 mm, was 3.5) and Wed 28 eased to 5.2 mm (was 7.6). Thu 29 is still the windiest (12 kt, gusts 20). PAGASA still has nothing for Palawan.
